parts.text: In this experiment, you are to determine the focal length of a converging lens. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Place the lens so that its centre is a distance u = 25.0 cm from the illuminated object.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Record in Table 4.1 the distance u in cm from the centre of the lens to the illuminated object, as shown in Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Place the screen close to the lens. Move the screen away from the lens until a focused image of the object is seen on the screen.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Measure and record in Table 4.1 the distance v in cm from the centre of the lens to the screen. Table 4.1 u / cm v / cm f / cm [5]

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Calculate and record in the table the focal length f of the lens using the equation f = uv ( u + v ) .

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Place the lens so that its centre is 45.0 cm from the illuminated object.

parts.label: h
parts.text: (h) Calculate the average value of the focal length. Average value of the focal length = ............................................................... [3]
